title: b11000
description: rpc : invalidate cached compute graph when a referenced buffer is freed ( #24292 ) The server caches the most recent compute graph per device so that GRAPH_RECOMPUTE can re-execute it without resending tensor data. The cached graph nodes hold direct pointers to backend buffers that were live at graph_compute() time.
